verses.text: Ach in Diosal, il in koti. Tz'el waw yuj yaelal tzin ik'ani. Cha ab' in lesal.
Hato b'aj slajwik'och sti' lum lum tik tzin awaj t'ayach, tz'el yip in pixan swab'i. Ik' in k'e t'a yib'anh junok niwan k'een yik tzin kolchaji.
Ha ach ayachoch in kolnab'ilok. Icha junok kuartel aj t'ayin, tzin a kol t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
In gana tzin kajnaj t'a a kajnub' t'a masanil tiempo. In gana tzin k'ub'ej in b'a t'a yalanh a wach'k'olal, icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun.
Ach in Diosal, hab'nak tas in ti' wak'nak t'ayach, ix ak' in makb'en yet' heb' ay elk'och t'ay.
Najatokab' tzutej in k 'inal a in rey in tik. Niwanokab' ab'il swila'
yik swak'an yajalil t'a ichanh. Tanhwej in yet' a wach'k'olal, yujto tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Icha chi' ol ach in b'itej t'a masanil tiempo. Junjun k'u ol in k'anab'ajan b'aj wak'nak in ti' chi' t'ayach.
